description.autumn: We handle the leaf drop and cleanup so you don't have to before the ground freezes. Locally owned and operated, serving the Boise and Meridian area since 2025.
description.winter: From driveways to walkways, we keep your property clear and safe through the coldest months. Locally owned and operated, serving the Boise and Meridian area since 2025.

season._comment: Dates are MM-DD, compared against today's date to pick the theme. Autumn theme runs from autumnStart up to (not including) winterStart. Winter theme runs from winterStart through the rest of the year, until autumnStart comes around again next year. Change winterStart to 12-21 if you'd rather switch on the winter solstice instead of meteorological winter.
